lede: The one meeting with real stakes this week is Telluride's rescheduled Planning and Zoning Commission special session on Monday, November 2, where commissioners will consider a minor subdivision application to merge two lots at 510 W Columbia Avenue into a single 5,625-square-foot parcel — a land-use decision worth showing up for if you care about how property gets consolidated in town. Beyond that, it's a Halloween-heavy week: the parade, Young Frankenstein at the high school, the KOTO bash, Easy Jim's two-night run, and a full calendar of trick-or-treat events fill out Friday through Saturday.

notable.stake: P&Z votes on merging two West Telluride lots into one larger parcel.
